title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: Provide a set of production-ready RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and concise tool-calling quickstarts to accelerate internal and customer onboarding for tool integrations (SSM, calendar, knowledge-base). This PR bundles example agents, YAML templates for common RAG patterns, and accompanying docs site updates + quickstarts. Changes include: - RAG templates for customer-support, docs-search, and compliance-assistant (YAML + sample config). - Three tool-calling examples that show secure tool invocation, auth scoping, and fallback behaviour (SSM credentials example, calendar read/write example, and a KB updater example). - Quickstart guide pages on the docs site with step-by-step instructions and runnable snippets for the examples. - Minor API docs clarifications on agent lifecycle hooks and KV cache usage in RAG flows. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and examples - [x] Add docs quickstarts and sidebar entries - [x] Run unit and integration tests - [x] Get reviewer approvals - [x] Update examples CI config Notes: - CI initially failed on an unrelated lint rule (markdown link formatting) which I fixed in a followup commit. - No breaking API changes; all examples are built on the current stable agent SDK surface. - Linear references: ENG-4021 (RAG quickstarts), PM-214 (docs rollout). Commit summary: - Add templates/customer-support.yaml, templates/docs-search.yaml, templates/compliance-assistant.yaml - Add agents/tool-calling/{ssm_example.py, calendar_example.py, kb_updater.py} - Update redwood-examples README and quickstart docs - Update redwood-docs site sidebar and add rag-agent-quickstarts.md QA & testing: - Ran unit tests for examples harness locally (python 3.11 venv) - Integration smoke tests with local devstack for SSM and calendar mocks - Verified docs build (mkdocs) and sidebar ordering on staging site Migration/rollout: - Docs added under /guides/rag-agent-quickstarts and will be included in the next docs release. - No customer data migration required. Known limitations: - The SSM example includes a mocked credential flow; customers should wire their KMS/HSM as required. - Some example config fields are intentionally conservative (timeouts) and may be tuned per workload. Links: - Linear: ENG-4021 - Staging docs preview: /staging/rag-agent-quickstarts - Related PRs: redwood-examples/pr-56199 (earlier examples), redwood-docs/pr-55910 (sidebar changes)
